say:3:1013204001:1.text: Marilee, do you know where Fay went?
say:3:1013204001:1.source_cn: 梅瑞特，你有菲的消息吗？

say:4:1013204002:1.source_cn: 她不在营地？又跑出去了？

say:5:1013204003:1.source_cn: 原来你还不知道。菲失踪了！

say:6:1013204004:1.text: I remember she'd sneak out occasionally... but she'd never go too far.
say:6:1013204004:1.source_cn: 我记得她偶尔会溜出去……可是从不会走得太远！

say:7:1013204005:1.text: Oh no, if we lose her, someone will be upset... But at a time like this, who should we ask to find her?
say:7:1013204005:1.source_cn: 呜哇，要是弄丢了那位，有人会生气的……可这种时候，该拜...

say:8:1013204006:1.text: I've taken her around the camp's surroundings a few times; she shouldn't have gotten lost easily.
say:8:1013204006:1.source_cn: 营地周边，我带她走过几次，应该不太可能是迷路。

say:9:1013204007:1.text: Could she... be in danger? What if she encountered some powerful Hypogean or golem? She wouldn't be able to handle it alone!
say:9:1013204007:1.source_cn: 难道……遇到危险了？要是遭遇什么厉害的魔物、魔偶，她一...

say:12:1013204008:0.text: Seems like now isn't the best time for us to ask about the golems.
say:12:1013204008:0.source_cn: 看来现在，不是我们询问魔偶之事的好时机。

say:15:1013204009:1.text: Of course! A girl has gone missing, we gotta help find her!
say:15:1013204009:1.source_cn: 当然！有个女孩子失踪了，我们得帮忙去找才行！

say:16:1013204010:1.text: Searching blindly would take too much time. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think is the best way to find her?
say:16:1013204010:1.male: Searching blindly would take too much time. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think is the best way to find her?
say:16:1013204010:1.female: Searching blindly would take too much time. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think is the best way to find her?

say:20:1013204011:2.text: Fay told me powerful magisters can do anything! You can definitely come up with something... right?
say:20:1013204011:2.source_cn: 菲说过，强大的魔法师无所不能！你肯定能想出办法……吧？
say:20:1013204011:2.male: Fay told me powerful magisters can do anything! You can definitely come up with something... right?
say:20:1013204011:2.female: Fay told me powerful magisters can do anything! You can definitely come up with something... right?

say:23:1013204013:1.text: Agreed! Magister is definitely the strongest around here, we'll find Fay in no time!
say:23:1013204013:1.source_cn: 好可怕的洞察力……这么快就看出了主人的不凡！
say:23:1013204013:1.male: Agreed! Magister is definitely the strongest around here, we'll find Fay in no time!
say:23:1013204013:1.female: Agreed! Magister is definitely the strongest around here, we'll find Fay in no time!

say:27:1013204015:1.source_cn: 听起来很可靠嘛？走吧，能早一点确定那女孩的位置，她就多...

say:30:1013204016:1.text: May Dura watch over her... Please protect that girl!
say:30:1013204016:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上……千万保佑那女孩！
